title: Unregistered Exit Portal Causes Game Progression Soft-Lock at Level Finish
explanation: Player navigated the full course of Level01, reaching exit terminus coordinates (7316.6, 159.96) at frames 13156 and 13300, but goal.found remained false and no portal_entered or level_completed event was emitted. Violates lifecycle progression contract (Portal2D.gd:L11-L16), trapping the player in an uncompletable level.

title: Score Monotonicity Anomaly: Erroneous Score Deductions on Pickups
explanation: At frames 578, 861, 964, and 1714, collecting collectibles after reaching 500 points triggered unexpected_score_change anomalies decrementing score by 10 instead of adding points. Violates state monotonicity invariant (PlayerData.gd:L36-L43 set_score), corrupting cumulative player score.

title: Zero-Velocity Wall Collision Freezes Enemy AI Movement
explanation: At frames 3241 and 3242, enemy_reversed_at_wall recorded old_direction 0.0 and new_direction 0.0 for Enemy4. Multiplying zero velocity by -1.0 in Enemy.gd:L33 left Enemy4 permanently immobilized at (6563.42, 424.65), violating autonomous patrol kinematics.

title: Trapped Enemy Rapidly Oscillates Between Collision Boundaries
explanation: Enemy2 triggered 14 wall reversals ping-ponging back and forth between X=3640 and X=4360 every 108 frames across frames 400, 508, 1551, 1659, 1767, and 1875. Violates AI exploration contract (Enemy.gd:L31-L33), trapping the entity in an infinite oscillation loop.

title: Stomp Detection Tunneling Allows Enemy to Survive Stomp Attack
explanation: At frame 3244, stomp_attempted and enemy_stomped registered bounce velocity -1600 on Enemy4, but no enemy_killed event was emitted and Enemy4 survived. Violates combat resolution contract (Enemy.gd:L57-L63), permitting enemies to survive valid stomp attacks at high fall speeds.
